# NYAB Q2'26: Beating expectations

**Feed**: inderes-se  
**Published**: 2026-08-13  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This episode is an interview with NYAB CEO Johan Larsson covering the company's Q2'26 results, which beat expectations after a flat Q1 caused by early-stage projects and a cold winter. Themes include accelerating revenue as contracts move into execution, a record backlog (>EUR 500m plus ~EUR 600m in Phase 2 opportunities), the large Uppsala Tramway Phase 2 win (SEK 6.5bn, booked via a JV below EBIT), datacenter expansion, and a soft offshore consulting segment expected to improve margins in 2027.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NYAB — NYAB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Q2 beat with 19% growth and normalizing margins; record >EUR 500m backlog plus ~EUR 600m Phase 2 pipeline expected to materialize before year-end; H2 seasonally stronger.

#### Reasoning

Founder-CEO signals accelerating execution as early-design contracts convert to higher-margin delivery. Core Swedish civil-engineering unit posted 7.7% EBIT in a weak quarter, implying ~10%+ in H2. Backlog at record levels with EUR 600m Phase 2 (SSAB Luleå, datacenters) likely to convert. Ideal 20-25% growth cadence; Uppsala SEK 6.5bn adds visibility though booked below EBIT via JV.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Phase 2 contracts (~EUR 600m) fail to materialize by year-end
- if H2 margins do not normalize toward 10%
- if offshore consulting margins keep dragging into 2027
- if cost inflation erodes project margins amid volume ramp

> *"Avsaknaden av tillväxt i Q1 är en tidsfråga och ett undantag och tillväxten kommer. Och naturligtvis med den orderbok vi visar nu i slutet av Q2 tillsammans med alla dessa potentiella fas 2. Allt är på gång."*
